_meta.source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (ESA/Airbus, via AWS Open Data) — bathtub model, ocean-connected cells only
caveats: Bathtub model — ignores levees, pumps, drainage and erosion (same caveat class as NOAA's Sea Level Rise Viewer).
30 m elevation data — block-level accuracy, not parcel-level.
Extent shown is land below the water level and connected to the ocean.
